blockers.message: The no-bundle registry requires two reddit_story packages and 6-8 verified Drive images per package. The image generator is available, but this run exposes no generated-file listing/bridge that can supply the connector-native file_id required by Google Drive.upload_file. Without that file_id, Drive upload, read-back hashing, pixel decode, public-sharing verification, and mandatory per-shot checkpoints cannot be performed honestly.
blockers.impact: Two reddit_story packages were not authored because their required media cannot be supplied; no DONE marker is written, so rendering cannot fire on an incomplete slate.
